questions.explain: QGC does it all: firmware, airframe, calibrations, missions, logs.

questions.q: How does PX4 integrate with ROS 2?
questions.explain: uORB topics are exposed directly to ROS 2.

questions.q: Which mode requires a reliable GPS?
questions.explain: Position holds the position by GPS.

questions.q: The command to start SITL with Gazebo and the x500 quadcopter?
questions.explain: The uXRCE-DDS client starts by itself in SITL.

questions.q: When should you choose ArduPilot over PX4?
questions.explain: PX4 is stronger in research and ROS 2.

questions.q: The PX4 filter defaults (IMU_GYRO_CUTOFF 40 Hz, IMU_DGYRO_CUTOFF 20 Hz) compared with Betaflight:
questions.explain: PX4 is designed for large vehicles; for a 5" they are raised. Plus a notch from ESC telemetry (IMU_GYRO_DNF_EN).
